mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned muscle-compression and directional-arrow illustration shows how they help blood return to the heart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins was relatively repetitive after making the arterial vessels; its illustration adds a useful contrast but little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The venous-return result introduced contracting limb muscle as part of the mechanism, extending the simple expectation that valves prevent backflow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary: the visible parts and the goal made the sequence understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting vessel structure to exchange and return was useful, and a later connection to blood flow through the heart would be interesting.
